mechanism: Both drugs affect dopamine/monoamine systems; methylphenidate increases dopamine while deutetrabenazine (VMAT2 inhibitor) depletes vesicular monoamines, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects with potential for reduced efficacy or unpredictable motor responses.
action: Monitor for changes in movement disorder control and ADHD symptom management; consider dose adjustment or alternative stimulant if clinical response deteriorates; coordinate care between neurology and psychiatry.
